title: Unbounded total tensor projection for etale extension without quasi-compactness
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and u:U→X a separated etale morphism locally of finite type, as in [def-weil-etale-morphism] and [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let L be the actual sheafified etale sum extension of [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension] and R the exact inverse image of [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact] on A-module sheaves. For arbitrary unbounded cochain complexes P on U and H on X, there is a family of isomorphisms Tot(LP tensor H) ≅ L Tot(P tensor RH), where total tensor uses direct sums and the differential d_P tensor 1 + (-1)^p 1 tensor d_H from [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. The degreewise functors are the published L and R. No quasi-compactness, boundedness or flatness hypothesis is imposed. This statement asks only for the comparison family needed for acyclic tests; the separate finite-type totalization theorem retains all of its summand, naturality and homotopy clauses.

source.place: Tag 0GKF, canonical sheaf projection isomorphism, and its direct-sum total-complex construction; parent open K-flat proof step 5

proof.text: Put L=u-sum-shriek and R=u-star. Their published adjunction makes L preserve all coproducts. For each pair of degrees use the inverse of the canonical etaleLowerShriekTensorIso from [lem-pur-etale-projection-kan-comparison]. It is natural in both module sheaves.

In degree n, take the coproduct of these sheaf isomorphisms over p+q=n and follow by the coproduct-preservation comparison for L. Naturality for d_P and d_H intertwines both differential summands; additivity preserves the coefficient (-1)^p. The inverse in each degree intertwines differentials as well, yielding a complex isomorphism. The generic totalTensorIso implements this same construction for additive bifunctors and a coproduct-preserving L. The argument uses arbitrary direct sums and never quasi-compactness.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_sum_tensor_comparison
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (u : U ⟶ X) (hu : Etale u)
    [IsSeparated u] [LocallyOfFiniteType u] :
    Nonempty (TotalTensorComparison
      (curriedTensor (EtaleModuleSheaf U A)) (curriedTensor (EtaleModuleSheaf X A))
      (Etale.etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) u hu)
      (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) u))
